_comment__file_purpose: Controls feature extraction, dimensionality reduction, and template indexing for fast matching.

gen_repre_opts._comment__templates_version: Template version to load as input for representation generation.
gen_repre_opts._comment__object_dataset: Dataset name. Must match the dataset used during template generation.
gen_repre_opts._comment__object_lids: List of object IDs (LIDs) whose templates will be indexed.
gen_repre_opts._comment__extractor_name: Feature extractor configuration string. Defines backbone, patch stride, feature type, and normalization.
gen_repre_opts._comment__grid_cell_size: Spatial resolution (in pixels) used to aggregate features into grid cells. Typically equals ViT patch stride.
gen_repre_opts._comment__apply_pca: Whether to apply PCA to reduce feature dimensionality. Improves memory usage and matching speed.
gen_repre_opts._comment__pca_components: Number of PCA components retained. Lower is faster; higher preserves more discriminative power.
gen_repre_opts._comment__cluster_features: Whether to cluster features into a visual vocabulary. Required for TF-IDF matching.
gen_repre_opts._comment__cluster_num: Number of clusters (visual words). Larger values give finer discrimination but increase memory and compute.

template_desc_opts._comment__desc_type: Descriptor construction method. TF-IDF treats each template as a document over visual words.
